```{r, message=FALSE}

rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)

set.seed(42)
N_BOOT_REP = 500

# Dataset colours: the two ends of the RdBu ramp, so the panels match the
# published figure (red Biodiscover, blue EntoScan) instead of ggplot's default
# salmon/teal, and stay consistent with the RdBu density panels in the spider
# case study.
DATASET_COLS <- c("biodiscover-S" = "#D6604D", "EntoScan" = "#4393C3")
# name must match the shape scale's title, otherwise ggplot draws two legends.
# No fill scale: nothing maps fill here, and adding one only raises a warning.
scale_dataset <- scale_colour_manual(values = DATASET_COLS, name = "DATASET")

# learning_curve_csv = "01_runs/regression_resnet101/2025-11-20_10-59-32/epoch_results.csv"
# total_lines <- R.utils::countLines(learning_curve_csv)
# learning_curve <- fread(learning_curve_csv, nrows = total_lines - 2)

md_csv = "predictions.csv"
metadata <- fread(md_csv)

metadata = metadata[IS_VALID == TRUE]
metadata[, DRYMASS_MG_PRED := (BF_PRED*ROI_SIZE_MM)^3 ]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG := DRYMASS_MG^ (1/3)]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED := DRYMASS_MG_PRED^ (1/3)]
metadata[, sqrtAREA_MM := AREA_MM2^(1/2)]
```

## Data overview

``` {r, message=FALSE}
ggplot(metadata, aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, sqrtAREA_MM, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=.3)  + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") 
    

ggplot(metadata, aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, sqrtAREA_MM, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=.6)  + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    facet_grid( . ~ SPLIT)
metadata[, .N, by=c("DATASET", "SPLIT")]
```
## Area-based biomass prediction
```{r, message=FALSE}
area_model <- lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG ~ sqrtAREA_MM, metadata[SPLIT == "train"])
# area_model <- lmer(cbrDRYMASS_MG ~ sqrtAREA_MM + (1 | INSECT_ID),
#                    data = metadata[SPLIT == "train"])
summary(area_model)
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM := predict(area_model, metadata, allow.new.levels = TRUE)]
lims <- range(c(metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG, metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM))
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"],
       aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, 
           cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM, 
           shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) + geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_dataset +
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims)
ggsave("plot-area.svg", width = 16, height = 9, device = "svg")


summary_dt = rbindlist(
    lapply(1:N_BOOT_REP,
        function(x) {
          subset = metadata[SPLIT == "test"] [ ,.SD[sample(1:.N, 1),], by="INSECT_ID"]
          subset = subset[sample(1:.N,.N, replace=T)]
          out = subset[, .(cbrDRYMASS_MG,cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM, DATASET)]
          out[, REP := x]
          }
        )
)

performance_rep = summary_dt[, 
             .(
               MAE = mean(abs(cbrDRYMASS_MG-cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM)),
               R2 = summary(lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG))$r.squared
               )
           ,
           by=c("REP", "DATASET")]

performance_rep[,.(MAE = mean(MAE),
                   MAE_conf_l = quantile(MAE, c(0.025)),
                   MAE_conf_h = quantile(MAE, c(0.975)),
                   R2 = mean(R2),
                   R2_conf_l = quantile(R2, c(0.025)),
                   R2_conf_h = quantile(R2, c(0.975))
                   ), by=DATASET]



```
## CNN-based biomass prediction
```{r, message=FALSE}
# 
# ggplot(learning_curve, aes(epoch, train_loss)) + 
#   geom_line(colour="blue") +
#   geom_line(aes(y=val_loss), colour="red")  + 
#   scale_y_continuous(name="loss (train: blue, val: red)")
  
lims <- range(c(metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG, metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED))
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"], 
       aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, 
           cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED, 
           shape=DATASET, 
           colour=DATASET)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED), colour="black", fill="black",  inherit.aes = FALSE, method = "lm") + 
  scale_dataset +
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims)

ggsave("plot-cnn.svg", width = 16, height = 9, device = "svg")


summary_dt = rbindlist(
    lapply(1:N_BOOT_REP,
        function(x) {
          subset = metadata[SPLIT == "test"] [ ,.SD[sample(1:.N, 1),], by="INSECT_ID"]
          subset = subset[sample(1:.N,.N, replace=T)]
          out = subset[, .(cbrDRYMASS_MG,cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED, DATASET)]
          out[, REP := x]
          }
        )
)

performance_rep = summary_dt[, 
             .(
               MAE = mean(abs(cbrDRYMASS_MG-cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED)),
               R2 = summary(lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG))$r.squared
               )
           ,
           by=c("REP", "DATASET")]

performance_rep[,.(MAE = mean(MAE),
  MAE_conf_l = quantile(MAE, c(0.025)),
  MAE_conf_h = quantile(MAE, c(0.975)),
  R2 = mean(R2),
  R2_conf_l = quantile(R2, c(0.025)),
  R2_conf_h = quantile(R2, c(0.975))
  ), by=DATASET]


# summary(mod)
```


```{r, message=FALSE}

# --- Combine AREA + CNN predictions ---
plot_dt <- melt(
  metadata[SPLIT == "test"],
  id.vars = c("cbrDRYMASS_MG", "DATASET"),
  measure.vars = c("cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM",
                   "cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED"),
  variable.name = "MODEL",
  value.name = "PRED"
)

# --- Nice labels ---
plot_dt[, MODEL := factor(MODEL,
  levels = c("cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM",
             "cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED"),
  labels = c("Area model", "CNN model")
)]

# --- Shared axis limits ---
lims <- range(c(plot_dt$cbrDRYMASS_MG, plot_dt$PRED), na.rm = TRUE)

# --- R2 for the black pooled regression line ---
r2_dt <- plot_dt[, {
  fit <- lm(PRED ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG)
  .(R2 = summary(fit)$r.squared)
}, by = MODEL]

r2_dt[, label := sprintf("R² = %.3f", R2)]

r2_dt[, `:=`(
  x = min(plot_dt$cbrDRYMASS_MG),
  y = max(plot_dt$PRED)
)]

ggplot(plot_dt,
       aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, PRED,
           shape = DATASET, colour = DATASET)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .6) +

  # dataset-specific regression lines
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +

  # overall regression line (black)
  geom_smooth(aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, PRED),
              method = "lm",
              colour = "black",
              se = FALSE,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  geom_text(data = r2_dt,
          aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          hjust = 0,
          vjust = 1,
          size = 5) +

  facet_wrap(~ MODEL) +
  scale_dataset +
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
  labs(x = "Observed mass",
       y = "Predicted mass")

ggsave("plot-combined.svg", width = 16, height = 9, device = "svg")

# --- Show plot ---
